title: Electrochemical Synthesis and Characterization of Silver Nanoparticles (AgNPs) for Potential Biological Application: A Promising Approach
content: Multiple benefits of Ag nanoparticles (AgNP) are reported in the medical context: antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, anticancer and healing activity, among others [1-3]. Some studies reports that size can play an important role when interacting with a biological body. The optimal size for silver nanoparticles not to show considerable cytotoxicity is between 50 to 100 nm [4-7].
